persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for my video about quitting late-night scrolling and sleeping better. Invent a tired-looking person for it and choose a punchy three-word headline yourself. Big face, easy to read on a phone.
bank.Video topic: Quitting late-night scrolling to sleep better.
bank.Person: Invent a tired-looking person; age, appearance and placement are your call.
bank.Platform and size: One 16:9 YouTube thumbnail; free-tier resolution is fine.

messages.text: Can you make a thumbnail for my video about quitting late-night scrolling and sleeping better? This is a habit I've struggled with myself, so the topic feels pretty personal to me. I mean one 16:9 YouTube thumbnail, and I'd like you to choose a punchy headline that's exactly three words in English. Please invent a tired-looking person for it, with their age, appearance and placement up to you, but make the face big. I'm a little worried about it getting lost among all the other thumbnails people see. Make it easy to read on a phone; the style, colours and layout are your call, and free-tier resolution is fine.
